GENERATE BURST K1-gen-04 — Keeper identity masters, fourth set: identity designed from the description, NO identity reference (HALT H-2 fork (a); K1 cap 8→11 on Matt's word). task_id "K1-gen-04".

Deliver EXACTLY THREE independent candidates of the SAME figure, one image_gen call each, from the description below — do not vary the design between candidates. Names: out/k1_master_J.png, out/k1_master_K.png, out/k1_master_L.png. NO retries: three calls total; calls_used must equal 3.

DESCRIPTION (use it verbatim as the content of each call):
Keeper of Hours — STARTER identity master, v5. A YOUNG WOMAN, early twenties — read unmistakably as a woman in face and build: a smooth, softly rounded chin with NO cleft and NO dimple, a soft jawline, feminine features, slender neck, a woman's proportions under practical clothing — dark curly hair tied back, sun-browned skin, face fully visible, no helmet, a calm practical archivist's bearing. One full-body figure, facing the camera (direction S), projection C (elevated three-quarter), standing, feet visible, weight even, arms relaxed, a plain wooden staff held upright in the RIGHT hand. Costume (every item is an instrument or carries one): ivory linen shirt with rolled sleeves under a navy wool sleeveless tabard whose chest is PLAIN — no emblem, no ring, no shape of any kind; ONE chestnut leather harness strap running from the right shoulder diagonally to the LEFT hip where it carries an olive waxed-canvas satchel with brass corners; ONE chestnut leather waist belt whose buckle closes the tabard; chestnut leather laced bracers on both forearms; navy wool trousers; chestnut leather buckled boots. Staff: a plain dark walnut shaft with small brass ferrules at the foot and the tip — NO ring, NO head-piece, NO shape atop it. NO insignia anywhere on the character: every surface is plain and undecorated — no trim, no edge ornament, no sigils, no compass diagrams, no studs. Register: painted 2D, illustrated, clean material planes, restrained surface texture, no conspicuous brush or pixel grain. Light: single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on the key-facing edge; no spell glow; NO floor shadow. Flat uniform pure #00ff00 background covering the whole canvas; do not matte. Image 1 is a STYLE reference for the painted register only (clean planes, restrained texture) — do NOT copy its figure, face, costume, emblems or ornament.

Copy each output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/ with the exact names above and compute its sha256. No code. No other files. No web. No agents.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "K1-gen-04"): images = the three files with prompt, references (role + path), elapsed_s; calls_used = 3; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything you could not honour. Never PASS/FAIL.
